title: Whistle paced ASR latency
scope: Paced native runtime first-word and release-to-final; no app integration or physical microphone acceptance
summary: Six authored short holds completed under machine pressure; no default promotion.

environment.workload: Normal desktop apps, high retained system swap; no competing native build/model run observed in agreed window
environment.power_thermal: Per-attempt logs retained; no recorded thermal warning. Quiet ASR+voice reference workload not qualified.

provenance.model: Pinned original artifact, see raw report and retained metadata
provenance.source: Dirty shared checkout; function snapshots and linked-input hashes retained; not installed-app parity

limitations: One authored excerpt per language, repeated for timing; no independent corpus/physical mic/UI/polish/insertion/duplex acceptance.
High retained swap and low disk headroom; cannot rank unmeasured candidates or promote a default.
Original full-file throughput and accuracy belong to a separate experiment.
French short-hold final has6edits/22words; English1/20. Provisional and native committed text differ.
No supported CoreML artifact/export path found; any port needs parity, placement,storage and latency validation.
